parameters.query: SELECT id, domain, status, priority FROM domains WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY priority ASC, RANDOM() LIMIT 50;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({cmd: 'for d in ' + $json.domains_space + '; do echo "$d"; subfinder -silent -d "$d" 2>/dev/null; curl -s --max-time 20 "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.$d&output=json" 2>/dev/null | jq -r ".[].name_value" 2>/dev/null | sed "s/[*][.]//g"; done | sort -u | head -200', timeout: 300}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({cmd: 'SUBS="' + $('Prepare Web Targets').first().json.subdomains_newline + '"; echo "===HTTPX==="; echo "$SUBS" | httpx -silent -json -sc -title -td 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "===NAABU==="; echo "$SUBS" | naabu -silent -json -p 80,443,8080,8443,22,21,3306,8000 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "===SHODAN==="; FIRST=$(echo "$SUBS" | head -1); IP=$(getent hosts "$FIRST" 2>/dev/null | awk "{print \$1}" | head -1); if [ -n "$IP" ] && [ -n "$SHODAN_API_KEY" ]; then curl -s --max-time 20 "https://api.shodan.io/shodan/host/$IP?key=$SHODAN_API_KEY" 2>/dev/null; fi', timeout: 240}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({cmd: 'echo "' + $('Prepare Web Targets').first().json.subdomains_newline + '" | nuclei -silent -jsonl -tags cve,ssl,exposure -severity critical,high,medium,low -timeout 5 2>/dev/null || true', timeout: 600}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({cmd: 'D=/tmp/nikto_$$; mkdir -p $D; i=0; for url in $(echo "' + $('Prepare Web Targets').first().json.targets_newline + '" | head -3); do i=$((i+1)); nikto -h "$url" -Format json -o "$D/$i.json" -nointeractive -Tuning 1,2,3,b -maxtime 45 >/dev/null 2>&1; done; jq -c ".[]" $D/*.json 2>/dev/null; rm -rf $D', timeout: 400}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({cmd: 'for url in $(echo "' + $('Prepare Web Targets').first().json.targets_newline + '" | head -4); do python3 /opt/xssmap/xssmap.py --url "$url" --level 1 --output json --timeout 10 2>/dev/null; done', timeout: 400}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({cmd: 'for url in $(echo "' + $('Prepare Web Targets').first().json.targets_newline + '" | head -2); do echo "===SQLTARGET:$url==="; timeout 200 sqlmap -u "$url" --crawl=1 --forms --batch --level=1 --risk=1 --technique=BEU --smart -v0 --timeout=15 --retries=1 2>/dev/null; done', timeout: 700}) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const tlsx = $('Parse tlsx').first().json;
const nuclei = $('Parse Nuclei').first().json;
const nikto = $('Parse Nikto').first().json;
const xss = $('Parse XSS').first().json;
const sqli = $('Parse SQLMap').first().json;
let enrich = { assets: [], live_hosts: 0, open_ports: 0, shodan: null };
try { enrich = $('Parse Enrichment').first().json; } catch (e) {}
const scan_timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
return [{ json: {
  scan_timestamp,
  total_certs_scanned: tlsx.total_certs_scanned || 0,
  expiring_soon_count: tlsx.expiring_soon_count || 0,
  expired_count: tlsx.expired_count || 0,
  expiring_soon: tlsx.expiring_soon || [],
  expired_certs: tlsx.expired || [],
  all_cert_results: tlsx.cert_results || [],
  total_vuln_findings: nuclei.total_findings || 0,
  critical_count: nuclei.critical_count || 0,
  high_count: nuclei.high_count || 0,
  medium_count: nuclei.medium_count || 0,
  critical_findings: nuclei.critical_findings || [],
  high_findings: nuclei.high_findings || [],
  medium_findings: nuclei.medium_findings || [],
  all_findings: nuclei.all_findings || [],
  total_nikto_findings: nikto.total_nikto_findings || 0,
  all_nikto_findings: nikto.all_nikto_findings || [],
  total_xss_findings: xss.total_xss_findings || 0,
  confirmed_xss_count: xss.confirmed_xss_count || 0,
  confirmed_xss: xss.confirmed_xss || [],
  all_xss_findings: xss.all_xss_findings || [],
  total_sqli_findings: sqli.total_sqli_findings || 0,
  confirmed_sqli_count: sqli.confirmed_sqli_count || 0,
  confirmed_sqli: sqli.confirmed_sqli || [],
  all_sqli_findings: sqli.all_sqli_findings || [],
  live_hosts: enrich.live_hosts || 0,
  open_ports: enrich.open_ports || 0,
  assets: enrich.assets || [],
  shodan: enrich.shodan || null
}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ username: 'EASM Security Scanner', embeds: [{ title: $json.subject, color: $json.discord_color, timestamp: $json.scan_timestamp, fields: [ {name: 'Critical', value: String($json.critical_count), inline: true}, {name: 'High', value: String($json.high_count), inline: true}, {name: 'Medium', value: String($json.medium_count), inline: true}, {name: 'XSS', value: String($json.confirmed_xss_count), inline: true}, {name: 'SQLi', value: String($json.confirmed_sqli_count), inline: true}, {name: 'Expiring Certs', value: String($json.expiring_soon_count), inline: true} ], footer: {text: 'EASM Pipeline · ' + $json.new_findings_count + ' new'} }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ fields: { project: { id: $env.JIRA_PROJECT_ID }, issuetype: { id: $env.JIRA_TASK_ISSUETYPE_ID }, summary: $json.summary, description: $json.description, assignee: { accountId: $env.JIRA_ACCT_OWNER } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ fields: { project: { id: $env.JIRA_PROJECT_ID }, issuetype: { id: $env.JIRA_SUBTASK_ISSUETYPE_ID }, parent: { key: $json.parent_key }, summary: $json.summary, assignee: { accountId: ($json.severity === 'high' || $json.severity === 'critical') ? $env.JIRA_ACCT_HIGH : ($json.severity === 'medium' ? $env.JIRA_ACCT_MEDIUM : $env.JIRA_ACCT_LOW) } } }) }}
